servicesList.name: Smart Sandwich Panel
servicesList.summary: Lightweight interlocking prefabricated panels with a light EPS-and-cement core wrapped in 4.5 mm calcium silicate boards. Tongue-and-groove edges lock every panel into the next for fast, clean installation.
servicesList.content:
Smart Sandwich Panel is our flagship product — a modern, eco-friendly alternative to traditional brick and concrete hollow blocks. Each panel features a lightweight EPS-and-cement core protected by 4.5 mm calcium silicate boards on both faces. The precision tongue-and-groove design allows panels to interlock quickly and securely, significantly reducing installation time and labour costs.

These panels deliver excellent thermal and sound insulation, fire resistance, impact resistance, and built-in seismic strength. They are much lighter than conventional masonry, reducing structural load and foundation costs. Available in 50 mm, 75 mm, 100 mm and 120 mm thicknesses with lengths up to 3000 mm and standard width of 610 mm, they are ideal for interior and exterior walls, partitions and complete building envelopes in residential, commercial, healthcare, educational and industrial projects.

servicesList.name: Smart Solid Panel
servicesList.summary: Lightweight interlocking panels made from EPS beads, cement, sand, water and bonding agents, reinforced with mesh for extra strength. Both sides are plastered after installation for a smooth finish.
servicesList.content:
Smart Solid Panel is engineered for superior strength and durability while remaining lightweight and easy to handle. Manufactured from high-quality EPS beads, cement, sand, water and special bonding agents, each panel is reinforced with mesh to enhance structural performance and impact resistance.

After installation, both faces are plastered to create a smooth surface ready for final finishing. These panels offer outstanding resistance to impact, fire, moisture and seismic forces. They reduce building weight, speed up construction and lower overall project costs. Available in the same thickness and length options as our Sandwich Panels, Smart Solid Panels are an excellent choice for load-bearing walls, high-rise construction and projects demanding maximum resilience.

servicesList.name: Smart EPS Block
servicesList.summary: Lightweight construction blocks made from EPS beads, OPC cement, water and essential additives. Molded into various sizes for fast, economical and eco-friendly building.
servicesList.content:
Smart EPS Blocks provide a modern, sustainable alternative to traditional clay bricks and concrete blocks. Produced by mixing expanded polystyrene (EPS) beads with OPC cement, water and specialised additives, the material is precisely molded into different sizes and shapes.

These blocks are significantly lighter than conventional masonry, reducing structural load and foundation requirements. They offer good thermal insulation, are easy to cut and handle on site, and help accelerate construction timelines while generating less waste. Available in sizes such as 100×200×600 mm, 150×200×600 mm and 200×200×600 mm, they are ideal for infill walls, partition walls and non-load-bearing applications.

servicesList.name: On-Site Installation Service
servicesList.summary: Professional installation by trained Smart Panel crews using specialised tools for fast, precise and clean on-site assembly.
servicesList.content:
Our trained installation teams ensure every Smart Panel project is completed efficiently and to the highest standard. Using specialised equipment — cutting machines, drill machines, welding machines, thread hand drills and plumb bobs — our crews achieve accurate cuts, secure fixing and perfect alignment.

No heavy machinery or long learning curve is required. Panels are installed quickly with minimal labour, resulting in cleaner sites, shorter project timelines and lower overall costs. We also provide technical guidance and supervision so your project benefits from both premium materials and expert workmanship.

servicesList.name: Technical Consultation & Design Support
servicesList.summary: Expert guidance on panel selection, structural design, seismic performance and project optimisation for architects, engineers and contractors.
servicesList.content:
Choosing the right panel thickness, type and installation method is critical for performance and cost efficiency. Our technical team works closely with architects, engineers and contractors to recommend the most suitable Smart Panel solution for each project.

We provide detailed technical data, seismic performance guidance, thermal and acoustic calculations, and practical advice on foundation design and structural steel savings. Whether you are building a high-rise, hospital, school or residential project, our consultation service helps you maximise safety, speed and value.

blogs.content:
[H1] Korean Design House in Nepal: Build Faster and Safer with Solid Panels

[INTRO]
Korean-style homes are becoming popular in Nepal. They are clean, compact, bright and practical, and many homeowners want that look. The question is how to build it in a way that suits Nepal's climate, budget and earthquake risk. One answer is solid panel construction.

-------------------------------------
[H2] What Is a Korean Design House?
-------------------------------------
[PARAGRAPH]
A Korean design house usually means a modern home with a minimalist, functional look. Common features include:

[LIST]
- Clean lines and simple exteriors
- Efficient use of compact space
- Large windows and bright, airy interiors
- Neutral color palettes with a smooth finish
- Good insulation for comfort through the seasons

[PARAGRAPH]
These homes depend on precise, smooth walls, and that is where solid panels help.

-------------------------------------
[H2] Why Solid Panels Suit Korean-Style Homes
-------------------------------------
[PARAGRAPH]
Smart Solid Panel is a lightweight, interlocking prefab wall panel made from EPS beads, cement, sand, water and bonding agents, reinforced with mesh. Both sides are plastered after installation, so the walls come out smooth and ready to paint. That finish suits a modern, minimalist look.

[PARAGRAPH]
Panels come in factory-made sizes:

[LIST]
- Thickness: 50 mm, 75 mm, 100 mm, 120 mm
- Length: 2400 mm, 2700 mm or 3000 mm
- Width: 610 mm

[PARAGRAPH]
Because the dimensions are consistent, walls are straight and clean, which is important for a modern design.

-------------------------------------
[H2] Key Benefits for Your Korean Design House
-------------------------------------
[H3] 1. Earthquake-Ready
Lighter walls place less load on the structure, which lowers seismic forces. This matters in a country like Nepal.

[H3] 2. Faster Construction
Interlocking panels cut labor time. The manufacturer cites builds up to 50% faster than conventional methods.

[H3] 3. More Usable Space
Slimmer walls can add 5–8% more carpet area, which helps in compact designs.

[H3] 4. Lower Structural Cost
Lighter walls can reduce foundation and steel needs by about 5–6%.

[H3] 5. Comfortable Interiors
The EPS-cement composition helps keep rooms cooler in summer and warmer in winter, lowering energy use.

[H3] 6. Fire and Sound Performance
Smart Panel products are rated for 3–4 hours of fire resistance and 35–45 dB of sound insulation, based on the manufacturer's sandwich panel test data.

[H3] 7. Moisture Resistance
Panels resist dampness and mold better than many traditional materials.

[H3] 8. Eco-Friendlier
No kiln firing and no topsoil digging, unlike clay bricks.

-------------------------------------
[H2] Solid Panel Price in Nepal

[PARAGRAPH]
Smart Panel is listed on the Government District Rate List. The rates published on the manufacturer's website are:

| 75 mm           | NPR 351            | Exterior walls                |
| 100 mm          | NPR 410            | High-insulation exterior walls|
| 120 mm          | NPR 495            | Boundary walls, acoustic walls|

[PARAGRAPH]
Add-ons: installation at about NPR 26 per sq. ft. and accessories at about NPR 47 per sq. ft.

[NOTE]
Rates can change, and the published table covers Smart Panel products generally. Confirm current solid panel pricing with the sales team before budgeting.

-------------------------------------
[H2] Which Thickness Should You Choose?
-------------------------------------
[LIST]
- 50 mm: interior partition walls
- 75 mm: standard exterior walls for a house
- 100–120 mm: extra insulation, sound control or boundary walls

-------------------------------------
[H2] Construction Process at a Glance
-------------------------------------
[NUMBERED LIST]
1. Finalize your design with an architect or engineer
2. Prepare the foundation and steel framing
3. Fix panels into channels and interlock them
4. Plaster both sides for a smooth finish
5. Paint and finish interiors

[PARAGRAPH]
Installation needs only a cutting machine, drill, welding machine and plumb bob, with no cranes. Have a structural engineer approve the design for your site.

-------------------------------------
[H2] Beyond Homes
-------------------------------------
[PARAGRAPH]
The same panels work for schools, offices, factories, clinics and guard rooms. Smart Panel has been used in projects across Bhaktapur and Kathmandu, including Montessori schools, a fitness center and a garment factory.

-------------------------------------
[H2] Why Choose Smart Panel?
-------------------------------------

-------------------------------------
[H2] Frequently Asked Questions
-------------------------------------
[H3] What is a Korean design house?
A modern, minimalist home style with clean lines, efficient layouts and comfortable, well-insulated interiors.

[H3] Can I build a Korean-style house with solid panels?
Yes. Solid panels give smooth, straight, plastered walls that suit a modern minimalist design.

blogs.title: 5 Reasons EPS Sandwich Panels Are Best for Earthquake Protection in Nepal
blogs.author: Bimal Raj Gosai
blogs.authorRole: CEO, Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd.
blogs.excerpt: Discover why EPS sandwich panels reduce base shear structural forces during earthquakes and why leading structural engineers in Nepal specify Smart Panels for residential and commercial builds.
blogs.content:
Nepal lies in a seismically active zone, making earthquake safety the single most critical factor in structural engineering and architectural design. Traditional brick and concrete masonry structures contribute massive dead load weight to a building, which drastically increases the lateral inertia forces during ground acceleration.

1. Substantial Base Shear Reduction

Seismic inertial force ($F = m \times a$) is directly proportional to the mass of the building. Smart Panels feature a lightweight EPS-and-cement core wrapped in 4.5mm calcium silicate board skins, reducing wall weight by over 60% compared to traditional red brick masonry. Lower mass directly translates into lower base shear force acting on the foundation and beam-column joints.

2. Interlocking Structural Integrity

Smart Sandwich Panels feature tongue-and-groove interlocking side profiles reinforced with cementitious adhesive and steel anchoring. During seismic shocks, the panels act as a continuous shear wall diaphragm rather than individual brittle bricks that crack and collapse outward.

3. High Energy Dissipation & Ductility

The expanded polystyrene (EPS) core possesses elastic compressibility that absorbs and dissipates kinetic vibration energy. Instead of catastrophic brittle failure, the composite matrix absorbs lateral displacement energy, preventing collapse and protecting occupants inside.

4. Reduced Impact Hazard During Shaking

In traditional brick structures, falling brick debris during tremors poses a severe injury risk to occupants and rescuers. Smart Panels are securely anchored to steel or concrete frameworks with L-brackets and steel pins, remaining intact even during violent shaking.

5. Compliance with Nepal National Building Code (NBC)

Smart Panels satisfy the structural design requirements for non-load bearing and shear partition walls under the Nepal National Building Code (NBC 105:2020). Tested for density (124 kg/m³), axial strength, and bending moment resistance, they represent the modern benchmark for seismic resilience across all 77 districts of Nepal.

blogs.title: EPS Panel vs Traditional Brick Masonry: Cost, Speed & Lifespan Comparison
blogs.author: Er. Suman K. Sharma
blogs.excerpt: An in-depth cost analysis comparing EPS prefabricated sandwich panels against traditional red brick masonry for multi-story residential and commercial buildings in Nepal.
blogs.content:
When planning a residential, commercial, or institutional construction project in Nepal, builders frequently compare traditional brick masonry against modern EPS sandwich panels. While brick construction has been the historical norm, escalating labor costs, long cure times, and heavy structural loads make EPS panels significantly more economic.

1. Construction Speed: 50% Faster Build Times

Installing Smart Panels requires no wet plastering or multi-week curing periods. Tongue-and-groove panels click together seamlessly and can be erected at a rate of 35-40 square meters per worker per day—over 5 times faster than traditional brick laying and plastering.

2. Foundation & Column Cost Savings

Because Smart Panels weigh only 40-50 kg/m² (compared to 220-280 kg/m² for 9-inch brick walls), the overall dead load on columns, beams, and footings is reduced by 40-60%. Structural engineers can optimize column sizing and rebar steel reinforcement, saving up to 15-20% on sub-structure construction costs.

3. Eliminating Wet Plastering & Curing Labor

Smart Panels feature factory-smooth calcium silicate board faces ready for direct putty application and painting. Eliminating two-side cement plastering saves time, material costs (sand, cement, water transport), and eliminates plaster shrinkage cracks.

4. Thermal Comfort & Lifetime Energy Savings

With a low thermal conductivity coefficient (K-value ≤ 0.045 W/m·K), Smart Panels reduce indoor temperature swings by 4-6°C compared to single-layer brick. This translates into 30-40% savings on air conditioning and space heating electricity bills for decades.

blogs.title: Thermal Insulation & Energy Saving in Hot & Cold Climates of Nepal
blogs.author: Er. Prabhat Shrestha
blogs.excerpt: How Smart Panel's EPS core wrapped in calcium silicate boards drastically lowers AC and heating bills across the Terai heat and Himalayan cold.
blogs.content:
Nepal experiences extreme climate variation—from scorching 40°C+ summer heat in the Terai plains of Chitwan, Biratnagar, and Nepalgunj to freezing winter temperatures in high altitude zones. Building materials that regulate indoor thermal equilibrium are vital for human comfort and energy preservation.

1. Core Thermal Resistance Physics

Smart Sandwich Panels utilize expanded polystyrene (EPS) beads fused with high-grade cementitious matrix sandwiched between non-asbestos 4.5mm calcium silicate boards. The cellular microstructure of EPS locks trapped air pockets, inhibiting conductive heat transfer.

2. Summer Heat Shielding

In hot regions, traditional brick and concrete walls act as thermal sponges, storing solar heat all day and radiating it indoors throughout the night. Smart Panels reflect solar heat and possess low thermal mass, keeping interior spaces 4-6°C cooler during peak afternoon heat.

3. Winter Heat Retention

In colder months, Smart Panels prevent internal heater warmth from escaping through building envelope walls, keeping rooms cozy and comfortable while reducing electric space heater power consumption.

4. Sound Insulation & Acoustic Privacy

Beyond thermal performance, Smart Panels provide sound reduction of ≥35 dB to ≥45 dB, dampening external traffic noise, rainwater drumming on roofs, and room-to-room audio bleed.
